description: The place where Jacob wrestled all night with a divine visitor, was given the name Israel, and named the site "the face of God" (Genesis 32:24-30). Gideon later destroyed its tower after its men refused to help his pursuit of the Midianite kings (Judges 8:8-9, 17).
family_friendly_summary: Penuel is the place by a river where Jacob wrestled all night with a mysterious visitor from God. At dawn Jacob was given a new name, Israel, and he called the place "the face of God." Years later, Gideon tore down Penuel's tower when its people refused to help him.
